a.lede: Nvidia gave us access to its Vera data center CPU for testing against Intel's Granite Rapids-AP and AMD's EPYC Turin.
a.title: Benchmarking Nvidia’s Vera CPU for the data center — standalone Vera tested against Granite Rapids-AP and EPYC Turin

b.lede: Nvidia’s Vera CPU is now generally available on Oracle’s OCI Superclusters, a win for Nvidia as it moves past NVL72 to a standalone Vera deployment at a major hyperscaler.
b.title: Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment — our independent benchmarking of a local server reveals Vera's massive memory bandwidth lead over dual Xeon 6 server
